note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions: story chapters and named missions first, side strands second, collectibles and grinds last. Missable trophies are flagged in the phase where they must be done.

phases.goal: Finish the story and grab every missable on the way. Do the partner trophies and the one-off moments before the finale — after it, some cannot be replayed in free roam.
phases.name: Phase 1 — Story + missables

phases.goal: Clear every side-character strand and stranger chain. Each named strand counts toward the 8 strands of 'Strangers & Freaks'.
phases.name: Phase 2 — Strangers & side strands

phases.goal: Sweep Leonida for everything countable: areas, meditation spots, cards, WAiNK locations, vehicles. Use the in-game stats page to see what is short.
phases.name: Phase 3 — Collectibles & exploration

phases.goal: Grind the repeatable sets: shooting range golds, races, drone races, stunts, challenges, robberies and money. Check your stats counters and top up the lowest ones first.
phases.name: Phase 4 — Activities, robberies & money

phases.goal: Reach 100% completion for the second gold, then the platinum pops with the last trophy.
phases.name: Phase 5 — 100% & platinum
